feat(observatory-cli): inspect and replay --store

replay writes sessions and event pointers through to a SQLite store: with
--store <path>, or at [store].path when a config file is in effect (a plain
replay with no config still writes nothing). inspect <event-id> reads the
pointer from the store (read-only) and prints the raw line followed by a
newline; a moved or short file exits 1 with path, byte_offset and byte_len.
Store::open_existing opens a store read-only without creating it.
